environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on a hardened container runtime using gVisor (runsc) with overlay-redirect disabled. The container's root filesystem is a read-only squashfs layer. A dedicated tmpfs volume is mounted at /app/uploads with size=512M and the mount uses MS_NOSYMFOLLOW. The process runs under a custom seccomp-bpf profile that denies openat(2) calls where the resolved path (after kernel-level symlink and '..' resolution via RESOLVE_BENEATH flag enforcement in the io_uring subsystem) falls outside the /app/uploads subtree. Additionally, the container's pivot_root places /app/uploads as the only writable mount point visible to the process namespace — all parent paths (/, /app, /etc, /host) are mounted read-only with propagation set to MS_PRIVATE. The OCI runtime spec sets process.noNewPrivileges=true and masks /proc/self/mountinfo.

config.seccomp_profile: custom-archive-service.json with RESOLVE_BENEATH enforcement on openat2 and fallback EPERM on openat for paths outside /app/uploads
